summary.intent: Run Session 1 of the v1-alpha launch plan for the callisto release tool: fix pre-cycle aggregation (F1), drive release-PR decide from the version plan (F2), then ship Changesets v3 pre support (G), managed prerelease cycles via release PRs (H) and `status --since` (M). The lead later asked to ship G and M as independent PRs off main.
summary.outcome: F1 (#566) and F2 (#567) were pushed and merged. G (#571) and M (#570) were rebased on main, passed the full gate including `just ci`, and were pushed, linked to trails #457/#458 and marked ready. H is committed locally and waits for G to merge.

repo: Worktree branch names (worktree-wp-*) differ from PR branch names, so plain `git push` silently no-ops; push with `HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>` and verify with `git ls-remote`. This was saved as a memory note.
Repo gate is `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`, `just test`, plus `just ci`. Rules forbid stacked PRs, so dependent work waits for the base PR to merge.
Each user-visible change needs a changeset created with `callisto add --package ... --summary ...`.
Specs in docs/specs/*.json, docs/errors.md, docs/releasing.md and ADRs must be updated alongside behavior changes; this was done via small Python -I edit scripts with count==1 asserts.
`entire trail link` can race a fresh push ("branch does not exist") and needs retry with the idempotency key; then `entire trail ci-pr` opens the PR.
The JSON status report omits `diagnostics` when empty, which matters when writing CLI boundary tests.

In exit mode `plan_version` seeds a patch for every package still at a prerelease version, so `decide` opens the stable PR after `pre exit` even for inference-only packages; a reviewer claim to the contrary was wrong.

New public surface is permanent after 1.0: the `status --since` flag, the `changed-without-changeset` diagnostic, decision schema 3 with `consumedChangesets`, and removal of `inferred-release-without-changeset` and E318.

code.finding: `NamedBy` and the separate severities/reasons maps were replaced by `Seed`/`Source`. Sources are FreshChangeset, RetainedChangeset, Inference or Group. Only fresh sources release a package, while retained changesets still set severity. Fixed/linked group unions became one freshness-aware `union_group`.

E165 (`CommitVerificationFailure::ConsumedChangesetsDiffer`, renamed from `NoChangesetConsumed`) now compares the changesets a commit deletes with the decision's `consumedChangesets`; `reason_from_bump` errors on a missing reason instead of defaulting to Changeset.
`pre.json` rewrites now preserve the file's own key order, and unknown keys no longer move to the end.

`changed_since_ref` uses `paths_differing_from` plus the new `untracked_paths`, so three git processes regardless of workspace size. It counts only changesets added or changed since the ref. The README.md exclusion was redundant and removed after a surviving mutant.

friction: The F1 full suite is slow (1924 tests), so the work moved to F2 in a parallel worktree while it ran.
Stale or concurrent test and mutants runs wrote to the same log, producing confusing mixed output.
The sandbox blocked a `sed` edit to the mutants script, so the old script ran again and had to be stopped and rewritten.
The first mutants attempts failed because the test filter named a binary that exists only on H.
`just ci` on F1 failed at `audit` on RUSTSEC-2026-0542, fixed separately by #560.
`entire trail link` raced the push and had to be retried.
open_items: H (`worktree-wp-h-managed-prerelease`, E318 retirement) is held until #571 merges. Then it must be rebased onto main, re-gated and shipped to trail #457 with the known limits in its PR body.

Known limit: a stale release PR that deletes no changesets (inferred-only, or a prerelease PR in a v2 cycle) is not caught by E165's changeset check; only the Hold release PR workflow and the manifest check stop it.
Known limit: rerunning `version` locally before the prerelease is tagged re-infers the same commits, so a `release-trigger = "auto"` package plans another beta. The release-PR flow is unaffected.

Reviewer finding on F1: a linked group's `named_severity` excludes Group sources, so non-pre behavior may differ when a fixed group raises a member of a linked group (suggested fix `.filter(is_named).map(Seed::severity)`). Whether it was resolved is not visible in the transcript.
Review nit: an auto-package case could be added to `release_pr_pre_cycle_tests.rs`.
`crates/callisto-cli/CHANGELOG.md:387` still says decide refuses pre mode; left as history.
